name: Shinkiba Jinza
source:
President of the Shinkiba Detective Agency. A former detective, but he still partakes in investigations. A laid-back blockhead most of the time. Oosaki trusts him with all his heart.

[Translated from [url=https://adeltaz1.wixsite.com/owen]the official website[/url].]
